parks.name: Starved Rock State Park
parks.blurb: Sandstone canyons above the Illinois River; bald eagles, deer and turkeys.

parks.name: Garden of the Gods Wilderness
parks.blurb: Rock formations in Shawnee Forest; wild turkeys, deer, hawks and box turtles.

parks.name: Chautauqua National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Illinois River backwater; pelicans, bald eagles, ducks and egrets.

parks.name: Crab Orchard National Wildlife Refuge
parks.blurb: Lakes and forest; Canada geese, bald eagles, deer and turtles.

parks.name: Montrose Point Bird Sanctuary
parks.blurb: Chicago lakefront; migrating warblers, herons, owls and monarch butterflies.

parks.name: Illinois Beach State Park
parks.blurb: Lake Michigan dunes and marsh; sandpipers, deer, owls and frogs.

parks.name: Midewin National Tallgrass Prairie
parks.blurb: Restored prairie; bison, grassland birds, deer and coyotes.

parks.name: Pere Marquette State Park
parks.blurb: River bluffs; bald eagles, pelicans, deer and wild turkeys.

parks.name: Volo Bog State Natural Area
parks.blurb: Floating bog trail; sandhill cranes, frogs, dragonflies and turtles.

parks.name: Mississippi Palisades State Park
parks.blurb: River bluffs; bald eagles, turkey vultures, deer and owls.

parks.name: Morton Arboretum
parks.blurb: Tree garden near Chicago; deer, foxes, owls and frogs.
